items.reply: I change my classification to FP. The job calls `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and inherits the network read timeout; lacking an explicit timeout does not establish indefinite blocking. Processing every item in the configured feed supports the intended import/update behavior, and neither this loop nor its invocation from TopicRetriever demonstrates a meaningful performance defect. An item cap or overall deadline is speculative hardening without evidence of problematic feed sizes or runtime.
